shared_elements: human figure (three-dimensional carved body in A; figures in profile relief in B)
curved bands or lines across the surface
incised/relief carved motifs on a flat panel-like field
justification: The only real correspondence is that both involve the human form and both carry a carved disc/ring plus curved band motifs on a broad panel-like surface, which is about as generic as shared content gets. B depicts a specific narrative scene — a standing deity-like figure facing a kneeling adorant across an offering stand, with several registers of dense sign-writing — whereas A is a monumental figure itself bearing only sparse abstract curvilinear and circular devices, with no scene, no interacting figures and no script.
